scope: Untimed original Omarchy qualification with recorded PID-1 bootstrap; all v5 asset, workload, browser, retention and budget pins are inherited unchanged

desktopBootstrap.reason: The sanitized pinned image intentionally removes sudo policy, locks root and autologins omarchy on ttyS0. The frozen T01 workload writes /root and stages a tool under /usr/local/bin. A recorded COW-only qualification policy supplies the required root shell without modifying any pinned base chunk or production image.
desktopBootstrap.bootargs: root=/dev/vda rw console=ttyS0 earlycon=sbi plymouth.enable=0 init=/bin/bash -- -i
desktopBootstrap.rescuePrompt: PID-1 Bash root prompt before systemd
desktopBootstrap.handoff: Validate the COW-only policy with visudo, sync it, then exec /sbin/init as PID 1; continue through the image's unmodified serial autologin and require sudo -n -H /bin/bash to report uid 0 and HOME=/root.
desktopBootstrap.evidence: The initial witness precedes the bootstrap. Classify every bootstrap UART offer and disk completion in the saved journal, preserve the immutable image/manifest hashes, and compare the complete end state during replay. This is a local qualification session, not a production image change.
